sources.name: Resort Mountain Report
sources.description: Daily official snow stake readings (24h, 48h, 7-day, season-to-date), base depths, open lift and trail counts, surface conditions, and current mountain wind holds.

sources.name: Open-Meteo High-Resolution Ensemble
sources.description: Multi-model atmospheric forecast integrating ECMWF IFS (9km), GFS (13km), and HRRR (3km). Provides elevation-adjusted hourly snowfall, cumulative curves, freezing levels (0°C isotherm), sustained wind, and gust profiles.

sources.name: NOAA National Weather Service (NWS)
sources.description: Official meteorologist forecasts, winter storm warnings/watches, quantitative precipitation forecasts (QPF), and snow accumulation probability grids from the Reno weather office.

sources.name: California Data Exchange (CDEC) & SNOTEL
sources.description: Automated physical telemetry stations measuring real-time ultrasonic snow depth, snow pillow Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), and air temperature at high-altitude mountain locations (SQV at 8,010' and WC3 at 6,750').

sources.name: Caltrans Highway Operations (QuickMap & CWWP2)
sources.description: Official real-time highway chain controls (R-0, R-1, R-2, R-3) and mountain pass closures across I-80, SR-89, SR-28, SR-267, and US-50.

blends.label: Equal blend
blends.description: Equal-weight mean of six single models: ECMWF HRES, ECMWF AIFS, HRRR/GFS, RRFS, ICON and UKMO. GEM is left out: on held-out seasons at the SQV and WC3 pillows the blend without it is slightly better (storm-total error 0.62 vs 0.63 in over 379 cold site-days; 0.71 vs 0.77 in on the 95 days with AIFS). NBM is left out because it is already a blend. RRFS (NOAA's 3 km Rapid Refresh Forecast System, operational since November 2026, 84 h runs) is a member at weight 1; it is too new for a hindcast, so it has no skill score or bias correction yet, and it drops out after 84 h. Members missing at an hour are dropped from that hour; the blend stops when under half the member weight remains. Profile panels use the ECMWF IFS column.

blends.label: Elevation-adjusted blend
blends.description: Equal-weight mean of 7 single models with their precipitation adjusted to each tier's elevation and calibrated to the SNOTEL pillows. Each model's precipitation at each tier comes from a distance-weighted line through its own 3x3 neighborhood of grid cells against cell height (and distance across the crest), evaluated at the tier's height but at most 1,000 ft above the highest cell, then times one residual multiplier per model (ECMWF HRES 1.04, ECMWF AIFS 1.25, HRRR/GFS 1.12, ICON 1.17, UKMO 1.24, GEM 1.71) fitted against the SQV and WC3 pillows over WY2023-WY2027 (neighborhood_hindcast.py fit). Snow follows from the corrected liquid through each model's own snow fraction and SLR; temperature, wind and the profile panels are the same as the Equal blend. RRFS: no hindcast yet, so the elevation shift only (multiplier 1.0).
blends.weights_note: precipitation moved to each tier's elevation, calibrated to SNOTEL

blends.label: Skill blend (beta)
blends.description: Beta: weights fitted from a short-lead hindcast only (see fitted); they will be refit from the live per-model archive and longer-lead hindcasts before the beta label comes off. The six single models weighted by skill: weight = 1/MAE of each model's 12Z-12Z liquid against the SQV and WC3 pillows' snow-water gain on cold, wet days, scaled to average 1 (Open-Meteo Historical Forecast hindcast, 2025-03-01 to 2026-11-24, 62 site-days; blend_weights.py --hindcast). The five-model fit over WY2023 on ranks the members the same way. The hindcast uses short-lead runs, so the weights reflect day-1 skill. RRFS is included at weight 1.0 (the average) until it has a hindcast to fit.
blends.weights_note: weighted by hindcast skill (62 site-days); RRFS unfitted at 1.0

blends.label: Short-range blend
blends.description: NBM and HRRR/GFS as the major members, the other models as minor ones. Weights: NBM 3 throughout; HRRR/GFS 4 through 18 h, falling linearly to 1 by 48 h (where HRRR hands over to GFS); ECMWF HRES, AIFS, RRFS, ICON, UKMO and GEM 1 each. In the first 18 h NBM is 25% and HRRR/GFS 33% of the total; after 48 h NBM is 33%. NBM's hourly fields are the same NOAA product the NBH text bulletin is printed from. NBM already blends HRRR, GFS, ECMWF and others, so those models count twice here. RRFS (NOAA's 3 km Rapid Refresh Forecast System, operational since November 2026, 84 h runs) is a minor member; it is too new for a hindcast, so it has no skill score or bias correction yet, and it drops out after 84 h.
blends.weights_note: NBM and HRRR/GFS major to 48 h, then NBM

blends.label: ECMWF pair
blends.description: Equal-weight mean of ECMWF HRES (physics) and ECMWF AIFS (machine learning), both started from the same ECMWF analysis.

precip_correction.method: elevation line from each model's 3x3 neighborhood of grid cells (distance-weighted fit against cell height, plus distance across the crest), evaluated at the tier height (at most 1,000 ft beyond the cells), then one residual multiplier per model
